metas.name: The Body
metas.description: A group of misbehaving Catholic school girls experience prophetic visions after a dance-team initiation goes wrong, triggering mass hysteria throughout their town. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Furious
metas.description: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
metas.description: A certain atmosphere of horror is felt the week before the celebration of an unfortunate wedding. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: The Beauty
metas.description: The world of high fashion turns dark when international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways. FBI Agents Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett are sent to Paris to uncover the truth. As they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a sexually transmitted virus that transforms ordinary people into visions of physical perfection, but with terrifying consequences. Available on Hulu in 4K.
